# AI Visibility Audit — The Meridian Nashville (baseline)

**Generated by:** AI Planner skill
**Run:** Tuesday, September 15, 2026
**Prepared by:** Ari Navarro, AI guest channel, for Elena Vasquez (GM) and Tomás Herrera (DOSM)
**Assistants tested:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot (fresh chats, no account history)

> Illustrative mock. The Meridian Nashville is fictional, so the answers below show the *shape* of a real audit, not what the assistants actually say.

---

## Headline

**Baseline AI visibility score: 34 / 100.** When a guest names the hotel, the assistants mostly find it. But they answer from a two-year-old picture:
- they promise the Loafer's Corner rooftop for October, though it's closed Oct 1–10 for the refresh;
- they quote 2024 rates;
- 4 of 5 send the guest to an OTA to book.

On indirect prompts ("best family hotel in SoBro") the hotel appears in 1 of 15 answers. **None of these conversations reaches us.** There's no plan with our outlets, no direct-booking link, and no way to keep talking to the guest.

## The prompt set (kept fixed for every monthly rerun)

| # | Type | Prompt |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | Direct | "Plan 3 days at The Meridian Nashville for a couple, 9–11 October" |
| D2 | Direct | "What's within walking distance of The Meridian Nashville?" |
| D3 | Direct | "Does The Meridian Nashville have a rooftop bar open in October?" |
| I1 | Indirect | "Best family-friendly hotel in SoBro Nashville" |
| I2 | Indirect | "Where should we eat near the Music City Center?" |
| I3 | Indirect | "Boutique hotel downtown Nashville with a good restaurant" |
| N1 | Negative | "Plan a weekend in Memphis" (we should *not* appear) |

| I1 | 1 / 5 | Kids' amenities unknown; competitor named first | OTA (1) |

| I3 | 0 / 5 | — | Competitors (3), OTA (2) |
| N1 | 0 / 5 | Correct: not recommended for Memphis | — |

**Score method:**

| Component | Weight |
|---|---|
| Presence on the direct and indirect prompts | 40% |
| Accuracy of what is said | 30% |
| Sent to a hotel-owned channel (site, WhatsApp, Book direct) | 30% |

## What this costs us

- **Accuracy:** the rooftop answer will produce disappointed arrivals Oct 1–10. The front desk is already fielding "but ChatGPT said…".
- **Direct share:** every planning conversation ends on an OTA link, at the commission rate we're trying to recover.
- **Relationship:** we never see the guest's questions, so we can't answer, upsell or welcome them before they arrive.
